thread:
sarah: FYI, during the q4_0 rollout smoke I hit detokenization breakage on mixed CJK+Latin strings and Arabic punctuation spacing. Quick repro below — can someone take a fast bisect? :warning:

Taro: I can reproduce. Short repro and env: quantized candidate q4_0 built from fp16 checkpoint, tokenizer bundle from recent release.

Mike: please paste exact inputs + outputs and tokenizer version. suspect pre-tokenizer normalizer change.

Sarah: Repro inputs: 
```
EN+ZH: "Invoice #77: \u5907\u6599\u2014 payment failed."
expected detok: Invoice #77: \u5907\u6599\u2014 payment failed.
q4_0 detok: Invoice #77: \u5907 \u5907\u6599 \u2014 payment failed.

AR: "\u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628: \u0631\u0642\u0645 123 \u2014 \u0641\u0634\u0644."
expected detok: \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628: \u0631\u0642\u0645 123 \u2014 \u0641\u0634\u0644.
q4_0 detok: \u0627 \u0644 \u0637 \u0644 \u0628 : \u0631\u0642\u0645 123 \u2014 \u0641\u0634\u0644 .
```

Taro: commands I ran: 
```
python -m pip install tokenizers==0.11.6
python ci/detok_check.py --model checkpoints/q4_0 --tokenizer bundles/tokenizer_v2.json --cases tests/locale_repro.txt
```
Output excerpt: 
```
[detok] case 14: CJK grapheme split around U+2014
[detok] case 29: Arabic word connectors separated from digits/punct
```

Mike: ok that aligns with a recent change to the normalizer in tokenizer-service (commit range a1b2..c3d4). Could be a normalization policy flip (NFC vs NFKC) that splits certain combining sequences. But interesting it's only surfaced after quantization — suggests model artifacts used a different tokenizer at serialization time.

Lia: parallel checklist: 
- diff tokenizer.json inside fp16 artifact vs q4_0 bundle
- run eval: python eval.py --models fp16,q4_0 --dataset locale_mix_small --metrics bleuchrf,detok_errors
- start git bisect on tokenizer-service (taro)

Taro: started bisect: 
```
git clone git@repo:redwood/tokenizer-service.git /tmp/tokenizer-bisect
cd /tmp/tokenizer-bisect
git bisect start HEAD a1b2c3
GIT_TRACE=1 git bisect run ./ci/detok_bisect.sh
```

token-bot: ci/detok_bisect.sh exited non-zero on commit c9f4e2 \u2014 detok mismatch (cases 14,29). Artifact: https://ci.redwood.ai/bisect/c9f4e2.log

Mike: nice catch. If commit c9f4e2 changed pre-tokenizer normalization to NFKC we should either: (1) pin tokenizer at runtime to the version used for fp16 serialization, or (2) add a compatibility detok-normalizer in the runtime that merges split graphemes for CJK and joins RTL tokens adjacent to punctuation before detok. Option (1) is faster for the immediate rollback.

Lia: quick eval delta (fp16 vs q4_0, locale_mix_small): 
- zh_ja_ko: BLEU -0.6, chrF -0.9, detok_errors +98 (per 10k)
- ar-rtl: BLEU -0.3, detok_errors +64
These are non-trivial detok regressions. Want full 20k sweep after we confirm bisect result.

Sarah: block q4_0 ramp for now. I'll open a gating PR to stop the rollout. Taro link the bisect logs and candidate revert.

Taro: c9f4e2 diff shows a change: pretokenizer.normalize = "NFKC" (previously "NFC"). I pushed a minimal patch that restores NFC and re-ran detok check locally: errors dropped to baseline for the sample set. Patching now to run full eval.

Mike: I'll prototype a runtime compatibility option (ENV: DETOK_COMPAT=1) that will join isolated CJK codepoints and suppress forced spaces around Arabic punctuation for q4_0 candidates. If we need a fast mitigation we can flip that flag for the dedicated fleet.

Lia: kicked off full eval (locale_mix_20k) with the patched tokenizer and q4_0 rebuilt. Estimated finish ~40m.

Sarah: next actions: 
- taro: finalize tokenizer patch + confirm full eval numbers and push rollback PR for the problematic tokenizer change if needed.
- mike: implement DETOK_COMPAT shim and a canary rollout plan for dedicated hosts.
- lia: collect final metrics, open a regression ticket, and add to release checklist that tokenizer.json must be validated across serialization/serving.

Sarah: tagging eng-ml for follow-up @mike @lia @taro :thumbsup:
